visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair and bangs is shown in a medium close-up, wearing a cream-colored turtleneck and denim pants. She is indoors in a brightly lit room with green bamboo plants in the background. She holds a small white package and begins tearing it open with her hands. (2) She holds up a yellow and red box for a pregnancy test product, pointing to the product illustration. She gestures to a small blemish on her cheek while looking directly at the camera. Graphic overlays including a lightbulb and text lists appear periodically on the screen. (3) The scene shifts briefly to an ultrasound image of a fetus, followed by a shot of her legs in a bathroom. She is then seen back in the main setting, tearing open a foil pouch with slightly trembling hands. Her facial expression is expectant and nervous as she focuses on the object. (4) A close-up shows a white pregnancy test device displaying two distinct pink lines. Animated golden glitter and confetti effects are overlaid on the frame. The woman covers her mouth with her hand, her eyes welling with tears, exhibiting a deeply emotional and joyful expression as she holds the test stick toward the camera.
